output.reason: The question asks what to say before quoting a visit cost. U-BEN-COST-001-02 gives the exact Legal verbatim disclaimer: the cost is an estimate for a covered in-network visit, it can change, and it is not a guarantee of payment. U-BEN-COST-001-01 says to read that block before any dollar amount but does not contain the wording itself, so 02 is the unit that answers the question.
